text:
infra-bot: ALERT: high 5xx rate on ingress in eu-central-1 AZ-D (region eu-central-1d). Service impact > 30% for external traffic. Pager duty: paging nora_oncall and julio_sre :rotating_light:

nora_oncall: I'm on it. reading alert... what's the initial signal?

priya_prod: customer reports page: some API calls are failing with 502/504s. noticed starting ~10:02 UTC.

samir_infra: checking ALB/NLB metrics now. seeing connection_reset upstream counts spike on NLB targets in AZ-D. health checks toggling. logs show a surge of TLS handshake failures.

alex_neteng: could be noisy NIC or ASG scale event in AZ-D. I'm pulling VPC flow logs and route tables.

julio_sre: assigning incident commander to coordinate mitigation. @nora_oncall can you lead initial mitigation?

nora_oncall: I'll take IC. first step: reduce traffic to AZ-D and failover to healthy AZs. Priya, please escalate to CS for customer comms. @cs-tom flagged.

cs-tom: on it, drafting status: "We're investigating increased errors in eu-central-1. Engineers are actively mitigating. ETA unknown."

samir_infra: quick diagnostic snippets:
```
# show target health summary
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:... | jq '.TargetHealthDescriptions[] | {Id: .Target.Id, State: .TargetHealth.State, Reason: .TargetHealth.Description}'
# result: many targets in eu-central-1d -> unhealthy (connection-reset)
```

samir_infra: also seeing Envoy logs on ingress pods in eu-central-1d:
```
[envoy][warning][upstream] connection failed: reset by peer, while reading response headers
[envoy][error][http] downstream connection closed prematurely
```

alex_neteng: route53 healthchecks currently route weighted by AZ-lb -> traffic still split. changing routing to send 0% to AZ-D now.

priya_prod: please confirm plan before change, we need graceful drain to avoid request duplication.

nora_oncall: Do the change and enable session draining. samir, scale ingress-controller replicas in AZ-A/B, and increase NLB target capacity in healthy AZs.

samir_infra: running scale command:
```
kubectl -n ingress scale deploy/ingress-controller --replicas=6 --selector=zone!=eu-central-1d
# bumping ASG in eu-central-1a/b
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name ingress-pool-euc1a --desired-capacity 8
```

deploy-bot: route53 weighted record update initiated by alex_neteng. ID: r53-change-7890.

alex_neteng: changed weight -> eu-central-1d = 0, propagated to all NS. Confirmed decreased traffic to AZ-D from edge.

julio_sre: after route change, 5xx rate dropped from 32% -> 6% over 3m. still seeing connection_reset noise on remnants.

nora_oncall: good. next: isolate root cause in AZ-D. samir, check host-level metrics (NIC errors, kernel logs), any noisy scaling/maintenance events?

samir_infra: host logs show repeated ENETUNREACH followed by sg updates from cloud-init at 09:58 UTC on some hosts. (possible platform maintenance). Also saw heavy socket TIME_WAIT accumulation.

alex_neteng: VPC flow logs show asymmetric routing for a subset of instances in AZ-D — some public subnet routes bounced to a problematic transit gateway. Opening cloud provider ticket referencing transit-gw id tg-0abc.

nora_oncall: mitigation timeline so far:
- 10:05: route53 weight -> AZ-D 0%
- 10:08: scale up healthy AZs, drain AZ-D ALB targets
- 10:12: customer status posted by cs-tom
- 10:18: reduced global error rate to ~5-8%

priya_prod: customer impact: approx 18% of requests in EU customers experienced errors between 09:58-10:12 UTC. Targeted accounts: several SaaS customers with EU-only routing; CS notified for paid tiers.

samir_infra: additional logs from NLB show TLS handshake timeouts from some IP ranges. suspect flaky NIC/driver or host kernel update in that AZ. provider confirmed maintenance window overlapping our timeframe.

alex_neteng: provider ticket response: "We observed partial metro-level fabric maintenance affecting small percentage of hosts in eu-central-1d between 09:50-10:10 UTC. We recommend moving traffic away from affected AZ." Ticket# CLOUD-44721.

julio_sre: action items (short):
- Add automated route53 failover policy when more than X% targets unhealthy in an AZ (samir)
- Improve runbook for NLB target health drain (nora)
- Add observability on transit-gw path metrics (alex)
- Customer RCA and timeline (priya + cs)

nora_oncall: I'm going to do a soft restart of envoy sidecars in AZ-D hosts still flapping to clear TIME_WAIT backlog. doing rolling restart with 30s delay.

samir_infra: rolling restart command:
```
kubectl -n ingress rollout restart daemonset/envoy-proxy --field-selector=spec.nodeName=eu-central-1d-node-*
```

infra-bot: NOTE: scheduled restart executed, 54/60 pods restarted, 6 still terminating.

nth message (julio_sre): monitoring for signs of recurrence. no new spikes in last 12m.

priya_prod: CS: We pushed an update to affected customers. They're asking for ETA and whether data loss occurred. Any confirmation?

nora_oncall: no data loss expected; errors were connection-level. we'll include that in the incident postmortem. Priya, include estimated impacted % and affected time window.

alex_neteng: provider confirmed host-level maintenance was the likely root cause. Will request advanced notification next time and gating for scheduled host updates.

julio_sre: handoff: nora, I'm taking post-incident cleanup and postmortem. please hand back when you finish triage tasks.

nora_oncall: handing off to julio_sre at 10:29 UTC. leaving notes in incident runbook. final status: traffic routed away from eu-central-1d, error rate normalized.

cs-tom: closing customer page for now; will reopen if more impact.

samir_infra: final notes:
- root cause: partial metro fabric maintenance + host socket backlog -> NLB target connection resets
- mitigation: route53 weight shift, scale healthy AZs, restart envoys
- next steps: add autoswitch policy + provider SLA review

julio_sre: logging incident for postmortem: INCIDENT-2023-2019-euc1d-nlb. assigning action items.

nora_oncall: thanks all. good run. :thumbsup:

cs-tom: thanks team — I'll update customers with final summary and link to postmortem when ready.

infra-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring.
